mapper.insert: insert into APP_METRIC_LOG ( CREATE_TIME, NAME, VALUE, APP_CODE ) values( #{createTime}, #{name}, #{value}, #{appCode} )
mapper.select: select count(ev.EVENT_ID) from RM_EVENT_INFO ev where ev.WARN_TIME>=#{warnTime}

select SUM(CASE WHEN task.FLOW_TYPE = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS report, SUM(CASE WHEN task.FLOW_TYPE = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS issued, SUM(CASE WHEN task.FLOW_TYPE = '03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filing, SUM(CASE WHEN task.FLOW_TYPE = '04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upd, SUM(CASE WHEN task.FLOW_TYPE = '05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warn from rm_task_info task where task.HANDLE_TIME>=#{handleTime}
